articles.title: Ramayana Worldwide Box Office Collection Day 22: Ranbir Kapoor Film Nears Rs 1800 Crore
articles.description: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's Ramayana: Part 1 earned Rs 10 crore overseas, taking its total collection to Rs 592 crore. How much did the film collect globally after 22 days? Read on to find out.

articles.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya First Review: Ayushmann Khurrana Is 'Effortless', Sharvari 'Top-Notch' In Sooraj Barjatya Film
articles.description: Yeh Prem Mol Liya releases today, but the first reviews are out. Taran Adarsh has rated Sooraj Barjatya’s film four stars. It stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari.

articles.title: Inside Shom Hinduja and Aadya Sharma’s wedding invitation
articles.description: Shom Hinduja, son of Harsha and Ashok Hinduja, is set to marry Aadya Sharma in Mumbai in December 2026. Their wedding invitation, titled The Eternal Bond, draws inspiration from the five elements of Hindu philosophy, with Vedic verses and traditional rituals shaping the celebrations.

articles.title: Bengaluru content creator says, "I crossed Rs 10 lakh in October," revealing how 16 brand deals, Durga Puja campaigns and 30+ videos helped her earn over Rs 10 lakh in a month
articles.description: Monsoon Dey, a dynamic content creator from Bengaluru, has maximized her earnings through strategic brand partnerships during the festive season of Durga Puja. In an impressive October, she grossed over Rs 10 lakh, representing a high point in her freelance journey. Balancing 30 videos for 16 distinct brands, she juggled multiple projects effectively. Nonetheless, she notes that freelance income can be unpredictable, highlighting the evolving prospects of digital content creation.

articles.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope (30th November–6th December 2026): Rahu Enters Capricorn as Major Changes in Career, Relationships and Personal Goals Begin
articles.description: The Capricorn Weekly Horoscope points to an important week of personal development, professional responsibilities, and financial adjustments. Rahu and Ketu will transit on 5th December. This will be particularly significant as Rahu enters your sign and Ketu moves into Cancer. This may bring changes in your personality, relationships and approach towards life. You may become more ambitious and eager to achieve your goals. Avoid taking decisions under pressure. Maintaining emotional balance and clear priorities will help you make better progress.

articles.title: Indraneil Sengupta reveals how Freida Pinto made him feel at home on Unaccustomed Earth sets
articles.description: Indraneil Sengupta praised Freida Pinto for welcoming and supporting him during his first major international production Unaccustomed Earth.

articles.title: 'Hail Mary' BO day 1: Kunchacko's thriller opens with Rs 87 lakhs
articles.description: Kunchacko Boban's film 'Hail Mary' premiered on Thursday and raked in Rs 75 lakh at the Indian box office. The audience turnout was noteworthy, with 53,415 tickets sold across 717 screenings, particularly thriving during late-night shows. Directed by Vishnu Revikumar and based on G.R. Indugopan's novel, the film artfully weaves themes of nostalgia and modernity.

articles.title: Imtiaz Ali is happy to see Tamasha get love from viewers, took film's box office failure as lesson for Main Vaapas Aaun
articles.description: Tamasha completes 11 years of release today. The coming-of-age romantic drama film starred Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone.

articles.title: Britney Spears spends Thanksgiving with her family after issuing a public apology
articles.description: Britney Spears spent Thanksgiving with her family, including her parents and children, after a public apology. She addressed her past behavior and expressed her feelings towards her family through a now-deleted Instagram post. Spears revealed her struggles with communicating face-to-face about her emotions with family members, acknowledging her human flaws. The singer previously shared grievances regarding her family, particularly addressing her sister Jamie Lynn Spears and ex-partner Kevin Federline.

articles.title: Who is Heema? Meet the 17-year-old Jhabua girl who defied child marriage, pursued education, and earned David Beckham's praise
articles.description: Heema Ninama, a brave teenager from Jhabua, took a stand against an arranged marriage to chase her dream of education. With unwavering support from her school principal and teachers, she managed to successfully cancel her wedding plans. Her inspiring story even caught the eye of David Beckham, who praised her determination on social media.

articles.title: Call Me Bae Season 2: Ananya Panday caught in a love triangle with Gurfateh Pirzada and Vihaan Samat in latest poster
articles.description: Call Me Bae Season 2: Ananya Panday returns with Gurfateh Pirzada and Vihaan Samat as Prime Video's new poster hints at a love triangle. The series premieres December 17.

articles.title: Karan Johar thinks Farah Khan needs better interiors; look at her bedroom makeover
articles.description: After Karan Johar jokingly suggested that Farah Khan needed a bedroom makeover, the filmmaker's space received a luxurious revamp. From floor-to-ceiling glass panels and plush furnishings to smart automation, the transformation offers inspiration for homeowners.

articles.title: Akshay Kumar Defends His 8-Hour Work Rule Amid Bollywood Film Debates
articles.description: Akshay Kumar explains that his strict eight-hour work schedule causes Bollywood producers to avoid casting him. He defends his routine, citing international icons like Tom Cruise and Christopher Nolan to justify his efficiency and work-life balance.

articles.title: Ramayana: Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi meet Amit Shah in New Delhi after film's global success
articles.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah met Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Nitesh Tiwari and Namit Malhotra on Thursday, congratulating the ‘Ramayana: Part 1’ team on the film's global success and its portrayal of Lord Rama's ideals.

articles.title: Big Fat Wedding Season Gets Bigger
articles.description: Wedding season is in full bloom across the country and given the astounding figures this year, some new records are likely to be set.

articles.title: Behind 12-foot gates sits the Los Angeles fortress Kylie Jenner bought for $36.5 million in 2020; after cutting $10 million from its asking price, she is using AI-enhanced photos to market the mansion
articles.description: Kylie Jenner's attempts to sell the mansion have involved several starts and stops. She had first listed it in December 2025 and then removed it from the market in June. She had purchased the Los Angeles mansion for $36.5 million in 2020. It had remained listed for several months but failed to find a buyer. In June 2026, the property was taken off the market.

articles.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya: Jameel Khan Shares How Director Sooraj Barjatya Made Things Easier On Set For Actors - Exclusive
articles.description: Gullak actor Jameel Khan spoke exclusively to Zoom about his experiences on the Yeh Prem Mol Liya set. He praised the working style of Sooraj Barjatya and noted the director was always precise about what he wanted.

articles.title: How was Jonathan Frakes diagnosed with bladder cancer? 'Star Trek' actor recalls first symptom as a ‘red flag’
articles.description: Jonathan Frakes noticed pink urine before a fan convention and sought medical advice after concerns. He underwent a cystoscopy which confirmed the presence of cancer in his bladder. Following this, doctors performed a blue light cystoscopy to remove the tumors just days later. Frakes completed six weeks of chemo immunotherapy and had prostate surgery after his cancer treatment.

articles.title: Ravi Kishan's father opposed his acting career, thrashed him for wearing a saree in Ram Leela. 'He wanted to kill me'
articles.description: Ravi Kishan recalled how his father opposed his acting ambitions and thrashed him for wearing a saree in a Ram Leela performance. The actor revealed that his mother helped him leave home amid family tensions. Speaking on Koffee With Karan, he described his difficult journey, saying, “People walk and come up in life.
